items.title: Disney’s first CTO led an AI startup it once accused of copying its characters

items.title: In India, the new iPhone can arrive faster than a pizza

items.summary: An aircraft equipped with Joby Aviation's autonomy technology flew across the United States without a human pilot taking control at any point.
